notes: Fix generic itinerary UI persistence and styling. Hokkaido day navigation labels remain data-driven and now survive normal page navigation without requiring Shift+F5 once the new release is activated. Generic Photo Credits now use the same compact paragraph typography and spacing as the original Japan itinerary credits instead of oversized custom rows. The shared update prompt is re-enabled by advancing the release version so existing v10.10.6 clients can detect and activate this build.
